decisions.reason: The accelerator program complements the firm's advisory services and innovation ecosystem, so it is likely retained despite being non-core.
Although the bitumen binder is outside the firm's core machinery focus, its CO2-negative positioning supports sustainability goals and warrants continued trial.
The infectious waste decontamination plant is closely aligned with the firm's modular waste-treatment capabilities and has strong launch visibility.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant is directly core to the firm's established plastic-waste recycling offer and is prominently featured.
